data.standardized_narrative: Argenta Syndicate 6134 experienced an overall strengthening of prior year reserves by GBP 3.0 million in 2019. This adverse development was attributed to deteriorations of GBP 2.0 million on casualty reinsurance and GBP 1.0 million on property reinsurance. The syndicate was impacted by several natural catastrophe events in 2019, including Australian bushfires, Townsville flooding, and Hurricane Dorian, as well as a significant man-made loss from non-payment of bunker fuel from Liberia. Prior year events from 2018, such as California wildfires and Hurricanes Michael and Florence, showed little net movement in the syndicate's position.
